en: Hello {supervisor}, sowing starts on {name} on {sow_date}. The crop is {crop} on {area_ha} ha. Please confirm the seedbed, the seed and the machines the day before.
mt: 你好,播种开始于1月2日. 收获在4公. 请确认种子床,种子和前一天的机器.

en: Hello {supervisor}, the seedbed on {name} is not ready for {crop}. Please tell me what is missing, such as rain, levelling or weeds, and when you expect it to be fine.
mt: 请告诉我什么是缺失的,如雨,平衡或杂草,什么时候你希望它会很好.

en: Hello {supervisor}, we will walk {name} together tomorrow at 7:00 to check emergence, weeds and any wet or stony patches. Please bring the field notes.
mt: 我们将明天7点一起走走,检查出现,杂草和任何潮湿或石头斑块. 请带上场地笔记.

en: Hello {supervisor}, you lead the soil sampling team on {name} ({area_ha} ha). The last test was on {last_test}. Take samples across the whole field in a W pattern and send them to the laboratory the same day.
mt: 你领导1公的土壤采样团队,最后一次测试是在3日.

en: Hello, the plan leaves {field} fallow this season ({area_ha} ha, planned crop {crop}). Please confirm whether it stays fallow or whether we sow a cover crop.
mt: 您好,计划在本季度留下 {field} 作物 ({area_ha} ha,计划作物 {crop}).请确认是否保持作物或是否种植覆盖作物.

en: Hello, the planting window for {crop} closes in {win_left} days. {field} is planned for sowing on {sow_date}. Please plan machines and seed so that we finish in time.
mt: 您好,种植窗口在1天内结束. 种植计划于3日. 请计划机器和种子,以便我们及时完成.

en: Hello, the plan for {field}: {crop}, sowing on {sow_date}, harvest on {harvest_date}, {area_ha} ha. Please read it and tell me about any problem before Friday.
mt: 您好,为 {field} 的计划: {crop},播种在 {sow_date},收获在 {harvest_date}, {area_ha} ha. 请阅读它,并在周五之前告诉我任何问题.

en: Hello, sowing of {crop} on {field} was due on {sow_date}. Please tell me the reason for the delay and the new date today.
mt: 您好,在1日播种 {crop} 应该在2日播种.请告诉我延迟的原因和今天的新日期.

en: Hello, the target of {target_t_ha} t/ha for {crop} on {field} is above the past average of {avg_hist} t/ha. Please review the target or the crop plan before we order inputs.
mt: 您好, {target_t_ha} t/ha 的目标 {crop} 在 {field} 超过过去的平均值 {avg_hist} t/ha. 请在订购投入之前检查目标或作物计划.

en: Hello, the budget for {crop} costs {total_ha} per hectare and leaves a margin of {margin_ha} per hectare. The break-even price is {be_price} per tonne. Please review the inputs before we order.
mt: 您好,每公的预算为1公,每公的利率为2公.平衡价格为每3公.请在订购之前检查输入.

en: Hello, we confirm our order of {need_kg} kg of {crop} seed for {field}. Please deliver before {sow_date} and send the lot numbers and the germination result with the delivery.
mt: 您好,我们确认了我们的 {need_kg} kg {crop} 种子 {field}. 请在 {sow_date} 之前交付,并与交付一起发送批次号码和发芽结果.

en: Hello, we need to move the delivery of {crop} seed for {field}. Sowing is on {sow_date}. Can you deliver at least five days before that date?
mt: 大家好,我们需要推迟1号种子的交付.播种时间是2号.你能在那个日期之前至少交付5天吗?

en: Hello, please send your best price for {need_kg} kg of {crop} seed, with the delivery date and the payment terms. We pay about {price_kg} per kg now.
mt: 您好,请发送您的最佳价格,包括交付日期和付款条款.我们现在每公斤支付约2美元.

en: Hello, the invoice for {crop} seed for {field} does not match our order of {need_kg} kg at {price_kg} per kg. Please check it and send a corrected invoice or a credit note.
mt: 您好, {crop} 种子的发票与我们每公斤的 {need_kg} 公斤的 {price_kg} 订单不一致. 请检查并发送更正的发票或信用票.

en: Hello, we sent soil samples from {field} today. We need pH, organic matter, nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium. Please confirm that you received them.
mt: 你好,我们今天从 {field} 发送了土壤样本.我们需要pH值,有机物质,,和.请确认您收到了它们.

en: Hello {landowner}, the lease of {field} ends on {lease_end}. We would like to renew it. Can we meet to talk about the rent and a longer term?
mt: 您好,我们希望续约租金.我们可以见面讨论租金和更长的期限吗?

en: Hello {landowner}, we plan to drill {field} soon. Please confirm that the gate is open and that we may cross the neighbouring track with the machines.
mt: 您好,我们计划很快进行种子钻探. 请确认门是开放的,我们可以通过邻近的轨道与机器.

en: Hello {neighbour}, the {boundary} between our field {field} and your land needs repair. It is {length_m} m long. Can we agree who does the work and when?
mt: 您的土地需要修复. 它是3米长的. 我们能同意谁做这项工作和什么时候吗?

en: Hello, please deliver {qty} {unit} for {field} ({action}) around {planned}. Tell us the day and the size of the truck so that we can prepare the spreader.
mt: 请告诉我们卡车的日期和尺寸,以便我们准备散布器.

en: Hello, we would like to book you for {action} on {field}, {area} ha, around {planned}. Please send your price and your first free date.
mt: 你好,我们希望为你预订1号,2号,大约3号. 请发送您的价格和您的第一次免费约会.

en: Hello {owner}, {kind} on {field}: {ha_affected} ha are affected and the problem is marked {severity}. Please start the repair this week and report back.
mt: 你好, {owner}, {kind} 在 {field}: {ha_affected} ha 被影响,问题标记为 {severity}. 请在本周开始修复并报告.

en: Hello, we sow {species} as a cover crop on {field} ({area_ha} ha). Please prepare the drill and {seed_kg} kg of seed.
mt: 您好,我们将种植1公的覆盖作物.请准备种子钻机和3公斤种子.

en: The planned revenue is {col:plan.revenue} and the planned cost is {col:plan.cost}, so the planned margin is {col:plan.margin}. The sowing check shows: {col:plan.check}.
mt: 预计的收入是 {col:plan.revenue},预计的成本是 {col:plan.cost},所以预计的利率是 {col:plan.margin}.

en: The latest soil test was on {col:fields.last_test}: pH {col:fields.ph} and organic matter {col:fields.om}. The pH check shows {col:fields.ph_state} and the organic matter check shows {col:fields.om_state}.
mt: 最新的土壤测试是对{col:fields.last_test}:pH {col:fields.ph}和有机物 {col:fields.om}进行的.pH检查显示 {col:fields.ph_state},有机物检查显示 {col:fields.om_state}.

en: For one hectare the budget holds seed {col:budget.seed}, fertiliser {col:budget.fert}, crop protection {col:budget.protect}, water {col:budget.water}, labour {col:budget.labour}, machinery {col:budget.machinery} and other costs {col:budget.other}. The total is {col:budget.total_ha}.
mt: 每公的预算包括种子 {col:budget.seed},肥料 {col:budget.fert},作物保护 {col:budget.protect},水 {col:budget.water},劳动力 {col:budget.labour},机械 {col:budget.machinery}和其他费用 {col:budget.other}.

en: At a yield of {col:budget.yield_t} tonnes per hectare and a price of {col:budget.price_t} per tonne the revenue is {col:budget.revenue_ha} and the margin is {col:budget.margin_ha} per hectare.
mt: 如果每公产量为0,每公价格为1,收入为2,利率为3.

en: The crop breaks even at {col:budget.be_yield} tonnes per hectare or at a price of {col:budget.be_price} per tonne. The budget for the whole area is {col:budget.budget}. The margin check shows: {col:budget.state}.
mt: 在每公0或每公1的价格下,作物均.整个面积的预算为{col:budget.budget}. 利率检查显示: {col:budget.state}.

en: The last crop on this field was {col:rotchk.last_crop} in {col:rotchk.last_year}. The planned crop was last grown {col:rotchk.since} years ago and needs {col:rotchk.rest} rest years.
mt: 这片土地上最后的作物是在1年. 计划的作物是2年前种植的,需要3年的休息.

en: The rotation check shows: {col:rotchk.state}, with a fit score of {col:rotchk.score} out of 100. The check was made by {col:rotchk.checked_by} on {col:rotchk.checked_on}.
mt: 转换检查显示: {col:rotchk.state},在100中得到了 {col:rotchk.score} 的合适分数.

en: Field: {col:soil.field}. Test date: {col:soil.date}. Laboratory: {col:soil.lab}.
mt: 测试日期: 1 实验室: 2

en: The soil pH is {col:soil.ph} ({col:soil.ph_state}). The organic matter is {col:soil.om} ({col:soil.om_state}). Nitrogen is {col:soil.n_ppm}, phosphorus is {col:soil.p_ppm} and potassium is {col:soil.k_ppm} milligrams per kilogram.
mt: 土壤的pH值为 {col:soil.ph} ({col:soil.ph_state}),有机物质为 {col:soil.om} ({col:soil.om_state}),为 {col:soil.n_ppm},为 {col:soil.p_ppm},为 {col:soil.k_ppm}毫克/公斤.

en: The test is {col:soil.age_days} days old and the age check shows: {col:soil.state}. The healthy pH range in our plan is {set:min_ph} to {set:max_ph}.
mt: 测试为 {col:soil.age_days} 天,年龄检查显示: {col:soil.state}. 我们计划中的健康pH范围为 {set:min_ph} 到 {set:max_ph}.

en: The fertiliser and lime plan for this field must follow these results. A field with a low pH needs lime before the next sowing.
mt: 农场的肥料和石灰计划必须遵循这些结果. 低pH的农场在下一次播种前需要石灰.

en: To {col:seed.supplier}. Crop: {col:seed.crop}. Field: {col:seed.field}, {col:seed.area} hectares.
mt: 农作物: 1 田地: 2 公.

en: We order {col:seed.need_kg} kilograms of seed at {col:seed.price_kg} per kilogram. The order value is {col:seed.cost}. The seed rate is {col:seed.rate_kg_ha} kilograms per hectare with a spare share of {col:seed.spare}.
mt: 我们以每公斤 {col:seed.price_kg} 的价格订购 {col:seed.need_kg} 公斤种子.订单值是 {col:seed.cost}.

en: We sow on {col:seed.sow_date}. Please deliver before that date, with the lot number, the germination result and the purity of the seed on the delivery note.
mt: 请在该日期之前交付,并将批次号码,发芽结果和种子的纯度写在交付单上.

en: Lease summary of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 租合同总结日期为 {set:firm}

en: To {col:lease.landowner}. Field: {col:lease.field}. Area: {col:lease.area} hectares.
mt: 面积为2公.
